reply_text:
I couldn't find which dock Marcus uses for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups, and I've told him so in a reply in his DM.

I looked everywhere he has access to: his DM with me, each channel he's in (#north-team, #north-random, #general, #help-it-ops, #inc-qfl-sev1), his notes, the North team files and the calendar. None of them mention Thornbury or a dock for it.

I suggested he check anywhere else he might have written it down, or ask Ilse Varga, the North team lead. I didn't open Ilse's DM with me or search across conversations he can't see, because those are off-limits when answering for him.
